title: Wembley Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical facilities, walk-in centres, and essential supply points for Wembley.
content:
For life-threatening medical emergencies, call 999 or 112 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals
- Northwick Park Hospital: Watford Road, Harrow HA1 3UJ. From Wembley Central station: bus 182 north along Watford Road direct to hospital grounds (~20 mins); or from Wembley Park station: 2 stops north on the Metropolitan line to Northwick Park station (~5 mins), then a 3 min walk.
- St Mary's Hospital (Major Trauma Centre): Praed Street, London W2 1NY. From Wembley Central station: ~25 mins on the Bakerloo line or London Overground south-east to Paddington / Queen's Park.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres
- Northwick Park Urgent Treatment Centre: Watford Road, Harrow HA1 3UJ (co-located with Northwick Park Hospital A&E).
- Central Middlesex Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Acton Lane, Park Royal NW10 7NS. From Wembley Central station: bus 224 south direct to the hospital (~20 mins).

3. Local Hazard Notes
- River Brent flows along the southern edge of Wembley (Tokyngton Recreation Ground), creating flood risk in adjacent low-lying paths; surface water pooling risk along Wembley High Road underpasses.

4. Essential Supplies
- Pharmacies and large retail outlets along Wembley High Road and Olympic Way / London Designer Outlet supply water, first-aid items, and medicines during outages.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
